messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["eagle", "octopus"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large standing bird of prey shown in right-facing profile with the head, feathering, wings, legs and taloned feet of a brown eagle, but with a cluster of long octopus-like tentacles bearing suckers hanging down from the rear where a tail would be. The plumage is dense golden-brown on the head and neck and darker layered brown on the folded wings and body, the legs are feathered to the yellow scaly feet, and pale circular suckers are also visible in patches on the lower belly and thighs.", "extra_limb_pieces": 6, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "eagle-like with brown feathers, fierce brow and golden-brown eye", "part": "head", "where": "top of body, in profile facing right"}, {"looks_like": "hooked raptor beak, yellow at the base and dark gray hooked tip", "part": "beak", "where": "front of the head"}, {"looks_like": "golden-brown with dark pupil and stern expression", "part": "eye", "where": "side of the head"}, {"looks_like": "folded with layered brown covert feathers and darker flight feathers", "part": "wings", "where": "sides of the body, one prominently folded on the near side and part of the second visible on the far side of the chest"}, {"looks_like": "dense brown plumage, golden-brown on neck and darker brown on wings and body", "part": "feathers", "where": "covering head, neck, torso, wings and upper legs"}, {"looks_like": "thick and feathered down to the ankle", "part": "legs", "where": "underside of the body supporting the bird"}, {"looks_like": "yellow scaly skin with large black curved talons", "part": "feet", "where": "at the bottom of the legs"}, {"looks_like": "long octopus-like arms with mottled brown skin and pale suckers on the underside, curling at the tips", "part": "tentacles", "where": "rear of the body hanging down behind the legs where a tail would be"}, {"looks_like": "pale circular sucker discs", "part": "suckers", "where": "along the undersides of the tentacles and in patches on the feathered thighs and lower belly"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 0, "walking_legs": 2, "wings": 2}
